proposals.mathematical_check: True. Since d_bs=|b−s|² and s0=S², sqrt(d_bs^6/s0^6)=d0^6. Since b0=B², sqrt(b0*d_bs^5/s0^6)=(B/S)d0^5. The square root of their maximum is exactly Phi, and the upward rational enclosure gives phi1≥Phi. Section 8 gives the actual relabeled residual bound κPhi; the displayed κphi1 is therefore an upper bound.
